questions.question: If a 10-digit number 1230x558y2 is divisible by 88, then the value of (5x + 5y) is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

If a number is divisible by 88 then it must be divisible by 8 × 11

When a number is divisible by 88 then its last three digits are also divisible by 8

∴ 8y2 is divisible by y when y = 3

When a number is divisible by 11 then difference of its sum of the alternate numbers will be zero or multiple of 11

The number 1230x558y2 = 1230x55832 will be divisible by zero

When

(1 + 3 + x + 5 + 3) - (2 + 0 + 5 + 8 + 2) = 0 or multiple of 11

⇒ (12 + x) – (17) = 0 or 11

∴ Possible value of x = 5

Now

**5x + 5y = 5 × 5 + 5 × 3 = 25 + 15 = 40**

questions.question: If cos x = -1/2 and π < x < 3π/2, then the value of 2 tan²x + 3 cosec²x is:
questions.solution:
Calculation:

cos x = -1/2 = cos 240°

∴ x = 240°

2tan²x + 3cosec²x = 2tan²240° + 3cosec²240° = 2tan²(180° + 60°) + 3cosec²(180° + 60°)

⇒ 2tan²60° + 3cosec²60° = 2 × 3 + 3 × (4/3) = 6 + 4 = 10

**Alternate Solution:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d3b56aef09abb168bf6a2bee3f0d0c3124be06ce7f68f2524b945f02d72e067.png] 

In ΔABC,

cos x = -1/2 = AB/BC

AC² = BC² + AB²

⇒ AC2 = 22 - 12

⇒ AC = √3

Given π 2x + 3 cosec2x

⇒ 2 × (√3)2 + 3 × (- 2/√3)2

**⇒ 6 + 4 = 10**

questions.question: The ratio between the speeds of two trains is 5 ∶ 7. If the first train covers 300 km in 3 hours, then the speed (in km/h) of the second train is:
questions.solution:
Given:

d1 = 300 km, t1 = 3 hr

**Concept:**

The ratio between the speeds of two trains is 5 ∶ 7.

Let the speed of two trains be 5x and 7x

We know that, speed=(distance)/(time)

**Calculation:**

Speed of first train (S₁) = 300/3 = 100 km/hr

⇒ 5x = 100

⇒ x = 20

**∴ Speed of second train = 7x = 7 × 20 = 140 km/h**37

questions.question: Two students, A and B, appeared for an examination. A secured 8 marks more than B and the marks of the former was 55% of the sum of their marks. The marks obtained by A and B, respectively, are:
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let marks of B be x

∴ Marks of A be x + 8

Now

According to question

(x + 8)/(x + x + 8) = 55/100

⇒ (x + 8)/(2x + 8) = 11/20

⇒ 20x + 160 = 22x + 88

⇒ 2x = 160 – 88 = 72

⇒ x = 36

**∴ Marks of A = x + 8 = 36 + 8 = 44**

**And marks of B = x = 36**

A, B, and C can complete a piece of work in 4, 20, and 60 days respectively. Working together, they can complete one-third of the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Time is taken by A to complete the work = 4 days

Time is taken by B to complete the work = 20 days

Time is taken by C to complete the work = 60 days

Total work = (LCM of 4, 20, and 60) = 60 units

The efficiency of A in 1 day = 60/4 = 15

The efficiency of B in 1 day = 60/20 = 3

The efficiency of C in 1 day = 60/60 = 1

1/3 of total work = 60 × 1/3 = 20

Efficiency of A, B and C together = 15 + 3 + 1 = 19

**Together they can complete one-third of the same work = 20/19 = 1(1)/({19)} days**

questions.question: If x% of y is 150 and y% of z is 300, then the relation between x and z is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide the two given conditions to directly eliminate the common term 'y':

(y% of z) ÷ (x% of y) = 300 ÷ 150

⇒ (y × z) ÷ (x × y) = 2

⇒ z ÷ x = 2 ⇒ z = 2x

**∴ The correct answer is z = 2x.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x% of y = 150

y% of z = 300

**Formula Used:**

a% of b = (a × b) ÷ 100

 
 x% of y = 150 xy = 15000 y% of z = 300 yz = 30000 
 Divide z ÷ x = 30000 ÷ 15000 = 2 

**Calculations:**

⇒ x% of y = 150

⇒ (x ÷ 100) × y = 150

⇒ xy = 15000 ... (1)

⇒ y% of z = 300

⇒ (y ÷ 100) × z = 300

⇒ yz = 30000 ... (2)

⇒ Dividing Equation (2) by Equation (1):

⇒ (yz) ÷ (xy) = 30000 ÷ 15000

⇒ z ÷ x = 2

⇒ z = 2x

**∴ The correct answer is z = 2x.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interchangeability of Percentages

An important fundamental property of percentages is that a% of b is mathematically identical to b% of a. Both evaluate directly to (a × b) ÷ 100.

Ratio Comparison Method

When solving algebraic equations with multiple variables where one variable acts as a common link (such as 'y' in xy and yz), dividing the two equations yields the most direct ratio of the remaining isolated variables.

Percentage Change Rule

To calculate the net percentage by which a base quantity A is more or less than B, always apply the base formula: [(A − B) ÷ B] × 100.

questions.question: If sec θ = 3x and tan θ = 3/x , (x ≠ 0) then the value of 9(x² – 1/x²) is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

sec θ = 3x ⇒ sec²θ = 9x² 

tan θ = 3/x ⇒ tan²θ = 9/x²

Now

sec²θ - tan²θ = 9x² – 9/x²

⇒ 1 = 9(x² – 1/x²)

**∴ 9(x² – 1/x²) = 1**

questions.question: The average age of four brothers is 14 years. If their father is also included, the average is increased by 4 years. The age of the father (in years) is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Average of four brothers = 14

Total age of four brothers = 14 × 4 = 56

After including father

New average = 14 + 4 = 18

Total age of four brothers and father = 18 × 5 = 90

**∴ Age of father = 90 – 56 = 34**

In triangle ABC, the length of BC is less than twice length of AB by 3 cm. The length of AC exceeds the length of AB by 9 cm. The perimeter of triangle is 34 cm. The length (in cm) of the smallest side of the triangle is:
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let AB = x cm

∴ BC = (2x – 3) cm

And AC = (x + 9) cm

The perimeter of triangle ABC = 34

⇒ x + 2x – 3 + x + 9 = 34

⇒ 4x + 6 = 34

⇒ 4x = 28

⇒ x = 7

**∴ Smallest side of the triangle = x = 7 cm**

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio of 7 : 5. On diminishing each of them by 40, the ratio becomes 27 : 17. The sum of the numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82098a2c1dbca240729b846786a99a6cb7a55a2d22a088ff53ad2a02a06e266b.png] 

∴ The sum of numbers = (35 + 25) × 5 = 300

**Detailed Solution:**

Let the two numbers be 7x and 5x

According to the question

(7x – 40)/(5x – 40) = 27/17

⇒ 119x – 680 = 135x – 1080

⇒ 135x – 119x = 1080 – 680

⇒ 16x = 400

⇒ x = 25

∴ The sum of the numbers = 7x + 5x = 12x = 12 × 25 = 300

questions.question: The chord of the contact of tangents drawn from a point on the circle x² + y² = a² to the circle x² + y² = b² touches the circle x² + y² = c² such that bp = amcⁿ, where m, n, p ϵ N, and m, n, p are prime to each other, then the value of m + n + p + 3 is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c331cc3d85df16ded591f39bc89920117054b5b8818b523bffb04fdc1fa754b.png] 

Let there is a point P(h, k) on the circle x2 + y2 = a2.

(h, k) will satisfy the equation x2 + y2 = a2.

⇒ h2 + k2 = a2 

The equation of the chord of the contact of tangents drawn from the point P(h, k) to the circle x2 + y2 = b2 will be

hx + ky = b2 

The perpendicular distance of this tangent from the center of the circle x2 + y2 = c2 will be equal to the radius of the circle.

⇒ |{-b² over sqrt{h²+k²}}| = c

⇒ |{-b² over a}| = c

⇒ b² = ac

Comparing it with bp = amcn 

⇒ p = 2, m = n = 1

**∴ m + n + p + 3 = 1 + 1 + 2 + 3 = 7**
